 The motivating source is Damasdi, Frankl, Pach and Palvolgyi, Monochromatic configurations on a circle, arXiv:2504.10687v2, Conjecture 3.1, DOI 10.5070/C6.68671. For that conjecture the substitution is the actual centered source on Fin k, sigma=finRotate k, Q=2^(k-2), and k>=3. The native source geometry and seam recurrence supply all bounds and permutation hypotheses. This settles the complete isolated, same-sign SMALL subcase, with arbitrarily many SMALL positions. The construction may change the order of different LARGE pairs. Sources containing adjacent SMALL labels or SMALL labels of both signs, and full Conjecture 3.1, remain open.
 
+**Theorem 1.2 (Both native cyclic filters and a strict prefix margin).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Circle/IsolatedSmallSource.actualSource_isolated_same_sign_cyclic_completion`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Circle/IsolatedSmallSource.actualSource_isolated_same_sign_cyclic_completion` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For the actual centered source on every physical label Fin k, k>=3 and arbitrary natural t, assume only that all SMALL values have one weak sign and that every SMALL label has a LARGE physical forward successor. One ordering of all labels has every natural take-prefix height h in [0,C], satisfies 28h<13N, ends at zero, is native Legal, and preserves the native forward cyclic order of both its LARGE and its SMALL filtered lists. Here N=2^k-1, Q=2^(k-2), and C=(N-1)/2. The witness is a physical permutation, is duplicate-free and exhausts Fin k. An empty SMALL filter and all-LARGE sources are included. Isolation itself excludes the zero source.
+
+Orient the common SMALL sign positively. The existing isolated_geometry bands show that every SMALL label a has a negative LARGE predecessor n and a positive LARGE predecessor p of n. Choose a physical positive LARGE root of minimum value p0. The label involution tau swaps each such adjacent negative/SMALL pair and fixes the other labels. Traversing the native cycle from the chosen root and mapping tau changes [p,n,a] to [p,a,n], and leaves [p,n] fixed. Scanning these disjoint adjacent pairs proves exact equality of each filtered order before restoring the native cyclic cut. Tau need not commute with the physical successor; no commuting conjugacy is asserted.
+
+Use the corrected integer potential P(i)=2w(i)-w(pred(i)) on SMALL phases, and P(i)=w(i)+N on negative phases or w(i) otherwise. Its successor difference is w(tau(i)). Prefixes therefore telescope to P(phase(j))-p0, including long natural takes and the zero endpoint after k physical steps. The geometry bounds 2N<=7p0, 3p<=N and 6a<N give 0<=P-p0 and 28(P-p0)<13N in all three phase categories. Since N=2C+1, integrality gives the half-strip bound. The potential is attached to physical labels, so repeated values, nonunits and proper numerical periods introduce no extra assumptions.
+
+For a nonpositive SMALL source, apply the construction to its negative and rotate the negated word at a maximum original prefix. Each resulting height is the old height at the cut minus another old prefix height, so it is nonnegative and at most the cut height. The old strict 13N/28 bound therefore transports explicitly, together with both filtered cyclic orders. The negate_rotation_prefix_bound theorem controls every rotated prefix by this cut height.
+
+This strengthens the isolated same-sign subcase motivated by Monochromatic configurations on a circle, arXiv:2504.10687v2. It supplies neither an ordering for arbitrary adjacent SMALL labels nor a resolution of full Circle Conjecture 3.1. The argument and library synthesis make no literature novelty claim.
+

@@ -68,6 +68,18 @@ Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Circle/TwoSmallSource.negate_rotation`
 
 For any integer-valued label word L in [0,C] with total zero, there is a cyclic cut j such that every natural prefix of L.rotate(j), evaluated with the negated weights, is again in [0,C]. Choose an attained minimum of the negated prefix sums. The existing nonnegative_rotate_of_minimum theorem gives the lower bound, while prefix_segment_sum and the original strip give the upper bound. The operation changes only the cyclic starting point and preserves every physical occurrence. Both the two-SMALL completion and the arbitrary-count isolated same-sign SMALL construction consume this same sign-restoration theorem.
 
+**Theorem 1.6 (Controlling the rotated prefixes by the cut height).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Circle/TwoSmallSource.negate_rotation_prefix_bound`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Combinatorics/Circle/TwoSmallSource.negate_rotation_prefix_bound` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For any integer-valued label word L in [0,C] with total zero, there is a cut j<=L.length for which every natural prefix of the rotated word with negated weights is nonnegative, at most C, and at most the original prefix height at j. A minimum of the negated prefix sums gives the cut. Splitting each rotated prefix at the seam expresses its height as an original prefix height subtracted from the cut height; all original heights are nonnegative. The negate_rotation theorem follows by forgetting the cut-height bound. In the isolated native completion, a strict upper margin on all original prefixes therefore bounds every new prefix, including the empty word, full word and takes beyond the length.
+
 The mathematical source context is Damasdi, Frankl, Pach and Palvolgyi, Monochromatic configurations on a circle, arXiv:2504.10687v2, Conjecture 3.1, DOI 10.5070/C6.68671. This result treats exactly two physical SMALL labels. Arbitrary-defect completion and the full global strict lexicographic exchange remain open.

@@ -506,4 +507,470 @@ theorem finite_isolated_small_completion {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
         omega
       exact he.trans hz
 
+
+/-- Swap precisely the negative/SMALL adjacent pairs of physical labels. -/
+private noncomputable def isolatedSwap {α : Type*} (σ : Equiv.Perm α)
+    (w : α → ℤ) (Q : ℤ) (i : α) : α :=
+  if w i < 0 ∧ |w (σ i)| < Q then σ i
+  else if |w i| < Q then σ.symm i else i
+
+/-- The correction on SMALL phases accounts for the adjacent label swap. -/
+private noncomputable def isolatedPotential {α : Type*} (σ : Equiv.Perm α)
+    (w : α → ℤ) (Q N : ℤ) (i : α) : ℤ :=
+  if |w i| < Q then 2 * w i - w (σ.symm i)
+  else w i + if w i < 0 then N else 0
+
+private theorem isolated_predecessors {α : Type*}
+    (σ : Equiv.Perm α) (w : α → ℤ) (Q : ℤ) (hQ : 0 < Q)
+    (hnz : ∀ i, w i ≠ 0)
+    (hs : ∀ i, |w i| < Q → 0 < w i ∧ Q ≤ w (σ i))
+    (hn : ∀ i, w i < 0 → 0 < w (σ i))
+    (hp : ∀ i, Q ≤ w i → w (σ i) < 0) :
+    (∀ i, w i < 0 → Q ≤ w (σ.symm i)) ∧
+    (∀ i, |w i| < Q → w (σ.symm i) < 0) := by
+  have negpred (i : α) (hi : w i < 0) : Q ≤ w (σ.symm i) := by
+    by_contra hh
+    by_cases ht : w (σ.symm i) < 0
+    · have := hn (σ.symm i) ht
+      simp only [σ.apply_symm_apply] at this
+      omega
+    · have hz := hnz (σ.symm i)
+      have hpos : 0 < w (σ.symm i) := by omega
+      have hsmall : |w (σ.symm i)| < Q := by rw [abs_of_pos hpos]; omega
+      have := (hs (σ.symm i) hsmall).2
+      simp only [σ.apply_symm_apply] at this
+      omega
+  refine ⟨negpred, ?_⟩
+  intro i hi
+  by_contra hh
+  have hz := hnz (σ.symm i)
+  have hpos : 0 < w (σ.symm i) := by omega
+  by_cases ht : Q ≤ w (σ.symm i)
+  · have := hp (σ.symm i) ht
+    simp only [σ.apply_symm_apply] at this
+    have := (hs i hi).1
+    omega
+  · have ht' : |w (σ.symm i)| < Q := by rw [abs_of_pos hpos]; omega
+    have := (hs (σ.symm i) ht').2
+    simp only [σ.apply_symm_apply] at this
+    have := abs_lt.mp hi
+    omega
+
+private theorem isolated_potential_geometry
+    {α : Type*} [Fintype α] [Nonempty α]
+    (σ : Equiv.Perm α) (w : α → ℤ) (Q N C : ℤ)
+    (hQ : 2 ≤ Q) (hN : N = 4 * Q - 1) (hC : C = 2 * Q - 1)
+    (hbound : ∀ i, -C ≤ w i ∧ w i ≤ C)
+    (hstep : ∀ i, w (σ i) = doubleStep N (w i))
+    (hsmall : ∀ i, |w i| < Q → 0 ≤ w i)
+    (hisolated : ∀ i, |w i| < Q → Q ≤ |w (σ i)|) :
+    ∃ o : α, Q ≤ w o ∧
+      (∀ i, isolatedSwap σ w Q (isolatedSwap σ w Q i) = i) ∧
+      (∀ i, isolatedPotential σ w Q N (σ i) - isolatedPotential σ w Q N i =
+        w (isolatedSwap σ w Q i)) ∧
+      (∀ i, 0 ≤ isolatedPotential σ w Q N i - w o ∧
+        28 * (isolatedPotential σ w Q N i - w o) < 13 * N) := by
+  classical
+  obtain ⟨hnz, hs, hn, hp⟩ := isolated_geometry σ w Q N C hQ hN hC
+    hbound hstep hsmall hisolated
+  have hslarge (i : α) (hi : |w i| < Q) : Q ≤ w (σ i) := by
+    have hpos := (hs i hi).1
+    have he := (hs i hi).2.1
+    have hh := hisolated i hi
+    rwa [abs_of_pos (by omega : 0 < w (σ i))] at hh
+  obtain ⟨negpred, smallpred⟩ := isolated_predecessors σ w Q (by omega) hnz
+    (fun i hi => ⟨(hs i hi).1, hslarge i hi⟩)
+    (fun i hi => (hn i hi).2.2) (fun i hi => (hp i hi).2.1)
+  have neglarge (i : α) (hi : w i < 0) : ¬|w i| < Q := by
+    have := (hn i hi).1
+    rw [abs_of_neg hi]
+    omega
+  have rootlarge (i : α) (hi : Q ≤ w i) : ¬|w i| < Q := by
+    rw [abs_of_pos (by omega : 0 < w i)]
+    omega
+  have hex : ∃ i, Q ≤ w i := by
+    let a : α := Classical.arbitrary α
+    by_cases ha : Q ≤ w a
+    · exact ⟨a, ha⟩
+    by_cases hn' : w a < 0
+    · exact ⟨σ.symm a, negpred a hn'⟩
+    · have hz := hnz a
+      have ha' : |w a| < Q := by rw [abs_of_pos (by omega : 0 < w a)]; omega
+      exact ⟨σ a, hslarge a ha'⟩
+  let roots : Finset α := Finset.univ.filter (fun i => Q ≤ w i)
+  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hex
+  obtain ⟨o, ho, hmin⟩ := roots.exists_min_image w ⟨a, by simpa [roots] using ha⟩
+  have ho' : Q ≤ w o := by simpa [roots] using ho
+  have hmin' (i : α) (hi : Q ≤ w i) : w o ≤ w i :=
+    hmin i (by simpa [roots] using hi)
+  refine ⟨o, ho', ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
+  · intro i
+    by_cases hi : |w i| < Q
+    · have hipos := (hs i hi).1
+      have hin := smallpred i hi
+      have hinlarge := neglarge (σ.symm i) hin
+      simp [isolatedSwap, hi, show ¬w i < 0 by omega, hin]
+    · by_cases ht : w i < 0 ∧ |w (σ i)| < Q
+      · have hnextpos := (hs (σ i) ht.2).1
+        simp [isolatedSwap, ht, show ¬w (σ i) < 0 by omega, ht.2]
+      · simp [isolatedSwap, ht, hi]
+  · intro i
+    by_cases hi : |w i| < Q
+    · have hipos := (hs i hi).1
+      have hn' := smallpred i hi
+      have hnlarge := neglarge (σ.symm i) hn'
+      have hsnext := hslarge i hi
+      have he := (hs i hi).2.1
+      have ht := (hn (σ.symm i) hn').2.1
+      simp only [σ.apply_symm_apply] at ht
+      simp only [isolatedPotential, if_pos hi, if_neg (rootlarge (σ i) hsnext),
+        if_neg (show ¬w (σ i) < 0 by omega), add_zero, isolatedSwap,
+        if_neg (show ¬(w i < 0 ∧ |w (σ i)| < Q) by omega)]
+      omega
+    · by_cases hn' : w i < 0
+      · have he := (hn i hn').2.1
+        have hnextpos := (hn i hn').2.2
+        by_cases ht : |w (σ i)| < Q
+        · simp [isolatedPotential, hi, ht, hn', isolatedSwap]
+          omega
+        · simp only [isolatedPotential, if_neg hi, if_neg ht, if_pos hn',
+            if_neg (show ¬w (σ i) < 0 by omega), add_zero, isolatedSwap,
+            if_neg (show ¬(w i < 0 ∧ |w (σ i)| < Q) by tauto)]
+          omega
+      · have hz := hnz i
+        have hi' : Q ≤ w i := by rw [abs_of_pos (by omega : 0 < w i)] at hi; omega
+        have hnnext := (hp i hi').2.1
+        have he := (hp i hi').1
+        simp [isolatedPotential, hi, neglarge (σ i) hnnext, hn', hnnext, isolatedSwap]
+        omega
+  · intro i
+    have horoot := hp o ho'
+    by_cases hi : |w i| < Q
+    · have hn' := smallpred i hi
+      have hr := negpred (σ.symm i) hn'
+      have hminr := hmin' (σ.symm (σ.symm i)) hr
+      have he1 := (hn (σ.symm i) hn').2.1
+      have he2 := (hp (σ.symm (σ.symm i)) hr).1
+      have hsmall' := hs i hi
+      simp only [σ.apply_symm_apply] at he1 he2
+      simp only [isolatedPotential, if_pos hi]
+      constructor <;> omega
+    · by_cases hn' : w i < 0
+      · have hr := negpred i hn'
+        have hminr := hmin' (σ.symm i) hr
+        have he := (hp (σ.symm i) hr)
+        simp only [σ.apply_symm_apply] at he
+        simp only [isolatedPotential, if_neg hi, if_pos hn']
+        constructor <;> omega
+      · have hz := hnz i
+        have hr : Q ≤ w i := by rw [abs_of_pos (by omega : 0 < w i)] at hi; omega
+        have hminr := hmin' i hr
+        have he := hp i hr
+        simp only [isolatedPotential, if_neg hi, if_neg hn', add_zero]
+        constructor <;> omega
+
+
+/-- Along a physical successor chain, each moved pair has one label of each
+size. Removing successive pairs proves the two filtered orders separately. -/
+private theorem isolated_swap_chain {α : Type*}
+    (σ : Equiv.Perm α) (w : α → ℤ) (Q : ℤ)
+    (hsmallpos : ∀ i, |w i| < Q → 0 < w i)
+    (hsmallnext : ∀ i, |w i| < Q → ¬|w (σ i)| < Q)
+    (hsmallpred : ∀ i, |w i| < Q → w (σ.symm i) < 0)
+    (fuel : ℕ) (L : List α) (o : α)
+    (hlen : L.length ≤ fuel)
+    (hchain : (L ++ [o]).IsChain (fun i j => σ i = j))
+    (hstart : ∀ a, L.head? = some a → ¬|w a| < Q)
+    (hend : ¬|w o| < Q) :
+    (L.map (isolatedSwap σ w Q)).Perm L ∧
+      (L.map (isolatedSwap σ w Q)).filter (fun i => decide (Q ≤ |w i|)) =
+        L.filter (fun i => decide (Q ≤ |w i|)) ∧
+      (L.map (isolatedSwap σ w Q)).filter (fun i => decide (|w i| < Q)) =
+        L.filter (fun i => decide (|w i| < Q)) := by
+  classical
+  induction fuel generalizing L with
+  | zero =>
+    have : L = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by omega)
+    subst L
+    simp
+  | succ fuel ih =>
+    cases L with
+    | nil => simp
+    | cons a tail =>
+      have ha := hstart a rfl
+      by_cases ht : w a < 0 ∧ |w (σ a)| < Q
+      · cases tail with
+        | nil =>
+          have he : σ a = o := (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hchain).1
+          exact False.elim (hend (he ▸ ht.2))
+        | cons b rest =>
+          have hab : σ a = b := (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hchain).1
+          have htail := (List.isChain_cons_cons.mp hchain).2
